sect1.title: OpenCL-Headers-&ocl-headers-version;

sect2.title: Introduction to OpenCL-Headers
sect2.para: This page covers the installation of the C and C++ headers of the OpenCL API, which allows running functions, or kernels, on CPUs and GPUs. This can speed up certain actions, allowing for better performance.

sect2.title: Downloading OpenCL-Headers
sect2.para: First, create a list of files to be downloaded:
To download the needed files using , use the following commands:

screen.userinput: mkdir ocl-headers && cd ocl-headers && grep -v '^#' ../ocl-headers-list | wget -i- -c \ -B &kg-url;

sect1.sect2:
Installation of OpenCL-Headers
&as_root;
First, start a subshell that will exit on error:
bash -e
Install all of the packages by running the following commands:
for package in OpenCL-{Headers,CLHPP} do longpackage=$package-&ocl-headers-version;.tar.?z* packagedir=${longpackage%.tar.?z*} tar -xf $longpackage pushd $packagedir mkdir build cd build cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \ -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \ -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF \ -D BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \ -G Ninja .. as_root ninja install popd rm -rf $packagedir done
Finally, exit the shell that was started earlier:
exit
